messages:
hana: FYI — bringup for zenika-v1 int6 shows a strong regression on mixed-orientation (JA/ZH with ruby + AR bidi). Quick smoke BLEU drop ~9 vs fp16.

noah: can you paste the eval summary and a sample?

hana: eval-bot output pasted below. ran on evaluation shard mixed-orient-2026-03.

eval-bot: MODEL=zenika-v1-int6
TASK=mixed-orient-translate
QUANT=int6 (runtime path)
BLEU=22.4 (int6) vs 31.3 (fp16 baseline)
avg_tokens/sent: int6=15.8 | fp16=12.1
FAIL_RATE(sample set)=0.12
example_input: "嵐(あらし) said سلام"
fp16_output: "嵐(あらし) said سلام"
int6_output: "嵐 said سلام" (ruby reading dropped, brackets reordered)

wei: interesting — token length increased under int6. that often points at pre-tokenizer normalization or a tokenizer fallback.

akiko: did we change vocab or tokenizer config during the onboarding? any merges/updates in the model artifact?

hana: model artifact unchanged from the importer. this appears when running the int6 kernels specifically — q4 run is much closer.

noah: reproduce steps i will try:
- checkout zenika-v1 on caller host
- run: `./eval --model zenika-v1-int6 --suite mixed-orient-2026-03 --save-fails`
- also run: `./eval --model zenika-v1-fp16 --suite mixed-orient-2026-03`

hana: tokenization quickinspect (local):
```
# tiny snippet used to compare tokens
from tokenizer import Tokenizer
T = Tokenizer('zenika')
s = '嵐(あらし) said سلام'
print('fp16', len(T.encode(s, mode='fp16')) )
print('int6', len(T.encode(s, mode='int6')) )
```
-> fp16 length: 12
-> int6 length: 18

noah: q4 test?
hana: ran q4 earlier: BLEU=30.9 (almost baseline). so regression is specific to int6 runtime path.

wei: could be a normalization quirk in the int6 preproc — maybe we fall back to a different normalization table for bytes above U+07FF or for ZWJ/ZWSP handling. Also bracket bidi reorder issues could be from detokenizer step using a different glue algorithm.

akiko: can someone dump token ids for the failing example from both runs and diff them? that should tell us whether split points changed.

hana: pasted diffs to thread gist (internal) and attached to ticket. rough diff: int6 introduced multiple single-char tokens for kana reading and split the Arabic word into smaller pieces; total tokens jumped.

noah: assigning to runtime/quant infra to bisect kernel changes. I'll start bisect across the int6 kernel commits (range 87a..9f2) and run the tokenizer-only unit to see where token-count skew appears.

akiko: also adding a deterministic detok test: detok roundtrip with mixed-orient samples so we catch orientation/bracket reorder regressions in CI.

hana: action items: 1) noah — bisect int6 kernel, report commit; 2) akiko — add tokenizer+detok smoke for mixed-orient to onboarding CI; 3) wei — audit normalization tables used by int6 preproc. Marking P0 for model onboard quality.

eval-bot: created ticket ML-1229 with failing examples and CI links: https://redwood.internal/ml/ML-1229

akiko: good. also flagging Dedicated infra to hold zenika int6 rollout until we confirm root cause.

noah: ack. starting bisect now — will update in ~2h with earliest suspect commit or repro script.

hana: thanks all :thumbsup:
